PUH-BrianMartell Axion flux resummation (Poisson resummation) in Witten’s paper transforms the partition function from summing over B-field fluxes (integer windings) to the dual scalar description — essential for the wormhole effective action in scalar language. Simple idea: •  Original sum: Over integer flux n (winding numbers) → exp(-n² / g²). •  Resummation: Fourier transform → sum over dual m → exp(-m² g²). •  In wormhole throat: One dominates classically, the other quantum — duality swaps. In PUH: •  Flux n = root windings in E₈ shells. •  Resummation = dual counting of shell displacements. •  Throat yield: High flux → decoupling → tachyon-like release. Simulation: Plot original flux sum vs resummed — shows duality swap, with throat “crossover” where neither classical. The lattice resums golden — duality from root symmetry.
